statement: The Gen 2 Linux built-in MP flag is a software classifier, not proof of physical identity for every integrated Plus. Early non-TR Plus can share the original Remote name and identifier, so no Gen 2-specific prediction is universal across early and later hardware. Exact child ID, routing, gyro priority and calibration responses remain unknown by revision.

applicability.revision: Early non-TR integrated Plus versus TR Gen 2
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. Linux classifier 570-605, 811-905; builtin module 2630-2666; wiiuse builtin recognition 45-80; #52 E1 not run.
